card.name: Numbers and units before a volume or size
card.fires_on: Digits and unit words such as mg, per, each or / inside a dose, strength or concentration expression, where a volume (mL), weight or body-surface-area unit is expected next.

modes.label: Concentration expressions
modes.description: The unit or divider in a concentration such as mg/mL, where a volume comes next.
modes.example: Vial Strength Volume of Diluent Final Concentration 100 mg 5 mL 20<< mg>>/mL 10 mL 10

modes.label: Per or each in rates
modes.description: Words like per or each linking an amount to a reference quantity.
modes.example: or a serum protein concentration of 5.2 g<< per>> 100 mL.

card.writes: It suppresses volume words, so it lowers the chance that a volume term follows.
card.plain: It fires inside dose and concentration expressions like 10 mg/mL, just before the next unit is written.
